soal.question: Manakah pernyataan yang benar mengenai permeabilitas efektif?

Permeabilitas batuan yang hanya mengandung satu fasa fluida
Rasio antara permeabilitas efektif dengan permeabilitas absolut
Nilai permeabilitas yang diukur pada kondisi tekanan vakum
soal.correct_option: Permeabilitas suatu fluida jika terdapat lebih dari satu fluida yang mengalir
soal.question_en: Which statement is correct regarding effective permeability?
options_en: The permeability of a fluid when more than one fluid is flowing
The permeability of rock containing only one fluid phase
The ratio of effective permeability to absolute permeability
The permeability value measured at vacuum pressure conditions
soal.correct_option_en: The permeability of a fluid when more than one fluid is flowing

soal.question: Apa yang dimaksud dengan permeabilitas relatif?
options: Rasio permeabilitas efektif suatu fasa terhadap permeabilitas absolut
Hasil perkalian permeabilitas efektif dengan porositas
Nilai permeabilitas yang diukur secara tegak lurus terhadap bidang perlapisan
Permeabilitas total batuan pada kondisi saturasi air 100%
soal.correct_option: Rasio permeabilitas efektif suatu fasa terhadap permeabilitas absolut
soal.question_en: What is meant by relative permeability?
options_en: The ratio of the effective permeability of a phase to the absolute permeability
The product of effective permeability and porosity
The permeability value measured perpendicular to the bedding plane
The total rock permeability at 100% water saturation
soal.correct_option_en: The ratio of the effective permeability of a phase to the absolute permeability

soal.question: Permeabilitas absolut didefinisikan sebagai permeabilitas batuan ketika...

Batuan dijenuhkan oleh campuran minyak dan air
Batuan dalam kondisi kering sempurna tanpa fluida

soal.question_en: Absolute permeability is defined as the rock permeability when...
options_en: The rock is saturated with only one fluid phase
The rock is saturated with a mixture of oil and water
The rock is in a perfectly dry condition with no fluid
soal.correct_option_en: The rock is saturated with only one fluid phase

soal.question: Bagaimana pengaruh clay (lempung) terhadap permeabilitas batuan?
options: Dapat menurunkan permeabilitas secara signifikan karena menyumbat pori
Meningkatkan permeabilitas karena sifatnya yang reaktif
Hanya mempengaruhi porositas tanpa mengubah permeabilitas

soal.question_en: How does clay affect rock permeability?
options_en: It can significantly decrease permeability by plugging pores
It increases permeability due to its reactive nature
It has no effect on permeability
It only affects porosity without altering permeability
soal.correct_option_en: It can significantly decrease permeability by plugging pores

soal.question: Alat manakah yang umum digunakan di laboratorium untuk mengukur permeabilitas sampel batuan core?

soal.correct_option_en: Permeameter

soal.question: Mengapa permeabilitas bisa bersifat anisotropik di reservoir?

Karena pengaruh kedalaman reservoir yang sangat dalam
Karena perbedaan jenis fluida yang mengisi pori
soal.correct_option: Karena adanya struktur perlapisan atau orientasi butir yang dominan
soal.question_en: Why can permeability be anisotropic in a reservoir?
options_en: Due to the presence of bedding structures or dominant grain orientation
Due to uneven distribution of water saturation
Due to the effect of very deep reservoir depth
Due to differences in the type of fluids filling the pores

soal.question: Apa yang dimaksud dengan Klinkenberg effect dalam pengukuran permeabilitas?
options: Koreksi permeabilitas akibat slippage gas pada pori-pori kecil
Koreksi akibat tekanan kapiler tinggi pada batuan karbonat
Fenomena penurunan permeabilitas akibat pengendapan mineral
Koreksi akibat adanya distorsi pada alat ukur
soal.correct_option: Koreksi permeabilitas akibat slippage gas pada pori-pori kecil
soal.question_en: What is the Klinkenberg effect in permeability measurement?
options_en: Permeability correction due to gas slippage in small pores
Correction due to high capillary pressure in carbonate rocks
Phenomenon of permeability reduction due to mineral deposition
Correction due to distortion in measuring instruments
soal.correct_option_en: Permeability correction due to gas slippage in small pores

soal.question: Berapakah definisi dari saturasi air (Sw) dalam suatu sistem pori batuan reservoir?
options: Rasio volume pori yang terisi air terhadap total volume pori
Rasio volume air terhadap volume bulk batuan
Persentase air yang dapat bergerak di dalam reservoir
Volume air yang terikat secara kimiawi pada permukaan butiran
soal.correct_option: Rasio volume pori yang terisi air terhadap total volume pori
soal.question_en: What is the definition of water saturation (Sw) in a reservoir rock pore system?
options_en: Ratio of pore volume occupied by water to total pore volume
Ratio of water volume to bulk rock volume
Percentage of mobile water in the reservoir
Volume of water chemically bound to grain surfaces
soal.correct_option_en: Ratio of pore volume occupied by water to total pore volume

soal.question: Manakah pernyataan yang paling tepat mengenai hubungan antara porositas dan permeabilitas pada batuan klastik?
options: Permeabilitas cenderung meningkat seiring dengan bertambahnya porositas efektif
Permeabilitas selalu berbanding lurus dengan porositas tanpa pengaruh ukuran butir

soal.question_en: Which statement best describes the relationship between porosity and permeability in clastic rocks?

Permeability is always directly proportional to porosity regardless of grain size
High porosity always guarantees high permeability
Permeability has no correlation with pore size

soal.question: Apa yang dimaksud dengan Net Pay dalam perhitungan cadangan hidrokarbon?

Ketebalan total formasi dari puncak hingga dasar reservoir

Ketebalan batuan dengan saturasi air di bawah batas maksimum
correct_option: Bagian dari reservoir yang mampu memproduksi hidrokarbon secara ekonomis
Ketebalan batuan dengan porositas di atas batas minimum
Ketebalan batuan dengan saturasi air di bawah batas maksimum
soal.question_en: What is meant by Net Pay in hydrocarbon reserve calculations?

Total formation thickness from the top to the base of the reservoir
Rock thickness with porosity above a minimum cutoff
Rock thickness with water saturation below a maximum cutoff

Rock thickness with porosity above a minimum cutoff
Rock thickness with water saturation below a maximum cutoff

Laju alir fluida saat pengujian sumur

Permeabilitas absolut hanya berlaku untuk gas
Permeabilitas efektif hanya diukur di laboratorium

soal.question_en: Why is absolute permeability different from effective permeability?

Absolute permeability applies only to gas

soal.question: Manakah parameter yang digunakan untuk membedakan antara Net Sand dan Net Pay?
options: Cut-off properti petrofisika (porositas, saturasi air, dan Vshale)
soal.correct_option: Cut-off properti petrofisika (porositas, saturasi air, dan Vshale)

options_en: Petrophysical property cut-offs (porosity, water saturation, and Vshale)

The ratio of total pore volume to grain volume

soal.question: Manakah di antara faktor berikut yang mempengaruhi pembacaan log Gamma Ray dan memerlukan koreksi lingkungan?
soal.question_en: Which of the following factors affect Gamma Ray log readings and require environmental corrections?

soal.question: Apa yang dimaksud dengan kondisi washout pada log Caliper?
options: Diameter lubang bor membesar akibat runtuhnya dinding lubang
Diameter lubang bor mengecil akibat pembengkakan serpih
Lubang bor memiliki diameter yang konstan
soal.correct_option: Diameter lubang bor membesar akibat runtuhnya dinding lubang

options_en: Borehole diameter enlarges due to wall collapse
Borehole diameter decreases due to shale swelling

soal.question: Log Gamma Ray mengukur radiasi alami yang dipancarkan terutama oleh unsur:

soal.correct_option_en: Potassium, Uranium, and Thorium

soal.question: Manakah dari komponen berikut yang berperan utama dalam pembentukan potensial listrik pada log SP melalui mekanisme perbedaan mobilitas ion antara filtrat lumpur dan air formasi?
soal.question_en: Which of the following components plays a major role in the generation of electrical potential in an SP log through the mechanism of ion mobility differences between mud filtrate and formation water?
soal.correct_option_en: Liquid junction potential

soal.question: Kapan defleksi log SP ke arah kiri (negatif) terjadi pada sumur bor?

Ketika terjadi kontak langsung antara fluida hidrokarbon dengan lubang bor
soal.correct_option: Ketika salinitas air formasi lebih tinggi daripada salinitas filtrat lumpur
soal.question_en: When does a negative (leftward) SP log deflection occur in a borehole?
options_en: When formation water salinity is higher than mud filtrate salinity
When mud filtrate salinity is higher than formation water salinity
When the rock zone is impermeable (shale)
When there is direct contact between hydrocarbon fluid and the borehole
soal.correct_option_en: When formation water salinity is higher than mud filtrate salinity

soal.question: Faktor apa saja yang memengaruhi besarnya defleksi SP pada zona permeabel?
options: Perbedaan salinitas antara air formasi dan filtrat lumpur
Derajat invasi filtrat lumpur ke dalam formasi
correct_option: Perbedaan salinitas antara air formasi dan filtrat lumpur
Derajat invasi filtrat lumpur ke dalam formasi
soal.question_en: Which factors influence the magnitude of SP deflection in a permeable zone?
options_en: Salinity contrast between formation water and mud filtrate
Degree of mud filtrate invasion into the formation
Radioactive mineral content in the rock
correct_option_en: Salinity contrast between formation water and mud filtrate
Degree of mud filtrate invasion into the formation

soal.question: Mengapa log SP tidak dapat digunakan untuk mengukur porositas secara langsung?
options: Karena log SP didasarkan pada arus elektrokimia, bukan sifat fisik batuan seperti porositas
Karena alat SP hanya bekerja pada lubang bor yang tidak berisi lumpur
Karena log SP hanya merespon kehadiran mineral logam konduktif
Karena log SP memerlukan sumber energi eksternal yang sangat tinggi
soal.correct_option: Karena log SP didasarkan pada arus elektrokimia, bukan sifat fisik batuan seperti porositas
soal.question_en: Why can the SP log not be used to measure porosity directly?
options_en: Because the SP log is based on electrochemical currents, not physical rock properties like porosity
Because the SP tool only works in boreholes without mud
Because the SP log only responds to the presence of conductive metallic minerals
Because the SP log requires a very high external energy source
soal.correct_option_en: Because the SP log is based on electrochemical currents, not physical rock properties like porosity

soal.question: Apa yang ditunjukkan oleh garis dasar (shale baseline) pada rekaman log SP?
soal.question_en: What is indicated by the shale baseline on an SP log recording?
soal.correct_option_en: Impermeable zones such as shale

options: Rt berbanding lurus dengan kuadrat Sw
soal.question_en: Which statement is correct regarding the relationship between true formation resistivity (Rt) and water saturation (Sw) based on Archie's Law?
options_en: Rt is directly proportional to Sw
Rt is inversely proportional to Sw
Rt is not influenced by Sw
Rt is directly proportional to the square of Sw
soal.correct_option_en: Rt is inversely proportional to Sw

soal.question: Faktor apa saja yang memengaruhi pembacaan resistivitas pada zona invasi (invaded zone)?

soal.correct_option_en: Induction log

soal.question: Pada zona flusher (flushed zone), saturasi fluida di dalam pori didominasi oleh:
soal.question_en: In the flushed zone, the fluid saturation within the pores is dominated by:
soal.correct_option_en: Mud filtrate

soal.question: Apa fungsi utama dari alat Induction Log dalam pengukuran resistivitas?
options: Mengukur resistivitas dengan arus listrik langsung
Mengukur konduktivitas formasi melalui induksi elektromagnetik
soal.correct_option: Mengukur konduktivitas formasi melalui induksi elektromagnetik
soal.question_en: What is the primary function of the Induction Log tool in resistivity measurement?
options_en: Measuring resistivity via direct electrical current
Measuring formation conductivity through electromagnetic induction
Measuring electron density in the formation
soal.correct_option_en: Measuring formation conductivity through electromagnetic induction

soal.question: Log densitas mengukur kerapatan elektron formasi yang kemudian dikonversi menjadi densitas bulk. Faktor utama yang mempengaruhi pembacaan alat densitas adalah:

soal.question_en: Which statements are correct regarding the limitations of the neutron log in porosity evaluation?
options_en: Influenced by clay minerals containing hydrogen
Cannot detect the presence of oil
Highly sensitive to the presence of gas
correct_option_en: Influenced by clay minerals containing hydrogen
Highly sensitive to the presence of gas

soal.question: Faktor fotolistrik (Photoelectric Factor/PEF) pada log densitas digunakan untuk:

soal.correct_option_en: Identify rock lithology

Sangat akurat untuk batuan dengan porositas sekunder tinggi
Memerlukan nilai transit time matriks dan fluida

Highly accurate for rocks with high secondary porosity
Requires matrix and fluid transit time values
correct_option_en: Used to calculate porosity from transit time
Requires matrix and fluid transit time values

soal.correct_option_en: Interval transit time

Kecepatan alat saat ditarik ke atas

Maximum depth the tool can reach in the well
Speed of the tool during logging

Mengukur kadar salinitas air formasi secara langsung

Directly detecting the presence of hydrocarbons

Hanya bisa digunakan di sumur dengan lumpur oil-based
Dapat mengukur porositas secara langsung tanpa alat neutron

Can only be used in oil-based mud wells
Can measure porosity directly without neutron tools
soal.correct_option_en: Provides better vertical resolution and multi-depth readings

options_en: There is no relationship between them

Zona yang tidak terpengaruh oleh lumpur sama sekali
Zona di mana mud cake terbentuk paling tebal
Bagian formasi yang memiliki resistivitas paling tinggi

soal.question_en: What is meant by the 'flushed' zone in the context of invasion?
options_en: The part closest to the borehole where almost all original formation fluids have been displaced
A zone not affected by mud at all
The zone where mud cake is thickest
The part of the formation with the highest resistivity
soal.correct_option_en: The part closest to the borehole where almost all original formation fluids have been displaced

correct_option: Untuk menghitung saturasi air di zona terinvasi
Untuk mengevaluasi kedalaman invasi mud filtrate
Sebagai perbandingan untuk koreksi invasi pada resistivitas dalam

To evaluate the depth of mud filtrate invasion
As a comparison for invasion correction on deep resistivity

To evaluate the depth of mud filtrate invasion
As a comparison for invasion correction on deep resistivity

options_en: Measures gamma ray attenuation due to Compton scattering
soal.correct_option_en: Measures gamma ray attenuation due to Compton scattering

soal.correct_option_en: Interval transit time (delta t)

soal.question: Faktor apa saja yang dapat menyebabkan pembacaan log neutron menjadi terlalu tinggi (overestimate)?

options_en: Presence of gas in the formation

soal.question: Persamaan Wyllie Time-Average digunakan untuk menghitung porositas berdasarkan data dari log apa?

soal.question: Pada formasi batupasir yang mengandung gas, apa dampak yang terlihat pada plot silang (crossplot) densitas-neutron?

soal.question: Apa yang dimaksud dengan 'Secondary Porosity Index' (SPI) dalam evaluasi log sonic?
options: Selisih antara porositas total (dari densitas/neutron) dan porositas primer (dari sonic)
Porositas yang diukur hanya pada lubang sumur yang tidak stabil
Porositas yang dihitung dari log gamma ray

soal.question_en: What is meant by 'Secondary Porosity Index' (SPI) in sonic log evaluation?

Porosity measured only in unstable boreholes
Porosity calculated from gamma ray logs
Rock porosity due to overburden pressure
soal.correct_option_en: The difference between total porosity (from density/neutron) and primary porosity (from sonic)

soal.question: Manakah pernyataan yang benar mengenai pengaruh litologi terhadap log densitas?

Log densitas tidak terpengaruh oleh jenis mineral
Log densitas hanya dipengaruhi oleh fluida
Log densitas selalu memberikan porositas yang benar tanpa koreksi litologi

soal.question_en: Which statement is correct regarding the effect of lithology on the density log?

The density log is unaffected by mineral type
The density log is only affected by fluids
The density log always provides correct porosity without lithology correction
soal.correct_option_en: The density log is very sensitive to rock matrix density

soal.question: Sumber radioaktif yang umumnya digunakan pada alat log densitas adalah?

soal.correct_option_en: Cesium-137

soal.question: Mengapa penggunaan log densitas dan log neutron secara bersamaan sangat krusial dalam evaluasi formasi?

options_en: To detect the presence of gas
correct_option_en: To detect the presence of gas

soal.question: Log gamma ray digunakan terutama untuk menentukan karakteristik apa dari formasi?

soal.correct_option_en: Lithology and shale content

soal.question: Faktor apa yang dapat memengaruhi pembacaan log resistivitas dalam lingkungan lubang bor?

soal.correct_option_en: Hydrogen

soal.question: Prinsip kerja log densitas didasarkan pada interaksi apa antara radiasi gamma dengan elektron batuan?

soal.correct_option_en: Compton scattering

soal.question: Apa fungsi utama dari log caliper dalam operasi wireline logging?
soal.question_en: What is the primary function of the caliper log in wireline logging operations?
soal.correct_option_en: Measuring borehole diameter

soal.question: Log sonic (akustik) mengukur waktu tempuh gelombang suara untuk menentukan apa?

soal.correct_option_en: Interval transit time porosity

soal.question: Mengapa koreksi borehole diperlukan pada data log?

soal.question_en: Why is borehole correction required for log data?

correct_option_en: Due to irregular borehole diameter effects

soal.question: Apa yang dimaksud dengan 'invasi' dalam konteks lingkungan lubang bor?

Bulk density is dry rock density, matrix density includes pores

soal.correct_option: Mengukur resistivitas zona formasi yang belum terinvasi

soal.correct_option_en: Density reads low, neutron reads low

soal.question: Log resistivitas dangkal (Shallow Resistivity) paling sensitif terhadap apa?
options: Zona formasi yang jauh dari lubang bor
Zona formasi yang jenuh minyak murni
soal.question_en: What is the shallow resistivity log most sensitive to?
options_en: Formation zone far from the borehole
Formation zone saturated with pure oil
soal.correct_option_en: Zone invaded by mud filtrate

soal.question: Apa kegunaan utama dari log SP di lapangan?
soal.question_en: What are the primary uses of the SP log in the field?

soal.question: Manakah pernyataan yang benar mengenai pengaruh mud cake pada log?
options: Dapat menyebabkan pembacaan log resistivitas menjadi tidak akurat
Tidak memengaruhi alat logging sama sekali
soal.correct_option: Dapat menyebabkan pembacaan log resistivitas menjadi tidak akurat
soal.question_en: Which statement is correct regarding the effect of mud cake on logs?
options_en: Can cause resistivity log readings to be inaccurate
Does not affect logging tools at all
soal.correct_option_en: Can cause resistivity log readings to be inaccurate

soal.question: Dalam kondisi lubang bor yang tidak stabil (washout), apa yang terjadi pada pembacaan log densitas?
options: Pembacaan densitas menjadi lebih rendah dari yang sebenarnya
Pembacaan densitas menjadi lebih tinggi dari yang sebenarnya
Tidak ada pengaruh pada pembacaan densitas
soal.correct_option: Pembacaan densitas menjadi lebih rendah dari yang sebenarnya
soal.question_en: In unstable borehole conditions (washout), what happens to the density log reading?
options_en: Density reading becomes lower than the actual value
Density reading becomes higher than the actual value
soal.correct_option_en: Density reading becomes lower than the actual value

soal.question: Log apa yang paling baik untuk mendeteksi mineral evaporit seperti halit?
soal.question_en: Which log is best for detecting evaporite minerals like halite?
soal.correct_option_en: Density-neutron log

soal.question: Apa tujuan dari melakukan 'environmental correction' pada data log wireline?
options: Menghilangkan pengaruh kondisi lubang bor dari data mentah
soal.correct_option: Menghilangkan pengaruh kondisi lubang bor dari data mentah
soal.question_en: What is the purpose of performing 'environmental correction' on wireline log data?
options_en: To remove the effect of borehole conditions from raw data
To increase the vertical resolution of the tool
To change the formation fluid type
To increase the tool's depth of penetration
soal.correct_option_en: To remove the effect of borehole conditions from raw data

soal.question: Manakah parameter utama yang diperlukan untuk menghitung volume shale (Vsh) menggunakan metode indeks gamma ray linear?
options: GR log, GR shale, dan GR clean
Indeks pori, saturasi air, dan permeabilitas
Tekanan kapiler, viskositas, dan suhu formasi
soal.correct_option: GR log, GR shale, dan GR clean
soal.question_en: Which main parameters are required to calculate shale volume (Vsh) using the linear gamma ray index method?
options_en: GR log, GR shale, and GR clean
Pore index, water saturation, and permeability
Capillary pressure, viscosity, and formation temperature
soal.correct_option_en: GR log, GR shale, and GR clean

soal.question: Pilihlah faktor-faktor yang dipengaruhi oleh keberadaan volume shale (Vsh) dalam evaluasi formasi.
soal.question_en: Select the factors that are influenced by the presence of shale volume (Vsh) in formation evaluation.

soal.question: Mengapa korelasi Larionov lebih sering digunakan dibandingkan model linear untuk menghitung Vsh dari log GR?
options: Model linear cenderung mengestimasi nilai Vsh terlalu tinggi
Model Larionov lebih sederhana secara matematis
Model linear hanya berlaku untuk batuan karbonat
Model Larionov tidak memerlukan data GR clean
soal.correct_option: Model linear cenderung mengestimasi nilai Vsh terlalu tinggi
soal.question_en: Why is the Larionov correlation more commonly used than the linear model to calculate Vsh from GR logs?
options_en: The linear model tends to overestimate Vsh values
The Larionov model is mathematically simpler
The linear model only applies to carbonate rocks
The Larionov model does not require GR clean data
soal.correct_option_en: The linear model tends to overestimate Vsh values

soal.question: Dalam konteks evaluasi log SP, apa yang terjadi pada defleksi kurva SP ketika volume shale (Vsh) meningkat?
options: Defleksi SP berkurang menuju garis dasar shale
Defleksi SP meningkat tajam ke arah negatif
Kurva SP menjadi datar dan tidak sensitif
Kurva SP menunjukkan nilai resistivitas yang sangat tinggi
soal.correct_option: Defleksi SP berkurang menuju garis dasar shale
soal.question_en: In the context of SP log evaluation, what happens to the SP curve deflection as shale volume (Vsh) increases?
options_en: SP deflection decreases toward the shale baseline
SP deflection increases sharply in the negative direction
The SP curve becomes flat and insensitive
The SP curve shows very high resistivity values
soal.correct_option_en: SP deflection decreases toward the shale baseline

soal.question: Koreksi efek shale pada porositas log densitas diperlukan karena shale memiliki densitas yang umumnya...
options: Lebih tinggi dibandingkan matriks batupasir bersih
Tidak memiliki pengaruh terhadap pembacaan alat
soal.correct_option: Lebih tinggi dibandingkan matriks batupasir bersih
soal.question_en: Shale effect correction on density log porosity is necessary because shale generally has a density that is...
options_en: Higher than the clean sandstone matrix
Exactly the same as formation fluid
Having no influence on tool readings
soal.correct_option_en: Higher than the clean sandstone matrix

soal.question: Manakah pernyataan yang paling tepat mengenai pengaruh keberadaan clay terhadap perhitungan porositas dari alat log densitas?
options: Clay cenderung meningkatkan densitas bulk sehingga porositas yang dihitung tampak lebih rendah dari aslinya
Clay tidak berpengaruh terhadap pengukuran densitas bulk
Clay cenderung menurunkan densitas bulk sehingga porositas yang dihitung tampak lebih tinggi dari aslinya
Keberadaan clay hanya memengaruhi pembacaan log neutron dan tidak pada log densitas
soal.correct_option: Clay cenderung menurunkan densitas bulk sehingga porositas yang dihitung tampak lebih tinggi dari aslinya
soal.question_en: Which statement is most accurate regarding the effect of clay presence on porosity calculations from density logs?
options_en: Clay tends to increase bulk density, making calculated porosity appear lower than it actually is
Clay has no effect on bulk density measurements
Clay tends to decrease bulk density, making calculated porosity appear higher than it actually is
The presence of clay only affects neutron log readings and not density logs
soal.correct_option_en: Clay tends to decrease bulk density, making calculated porosity appear higher than it actually is

soal.question: Dalam penentuan porositas efektif, faktor apa saja yang harus dikurangi dari porositas total?
soal.question_en: In determining effective porosity, which factors must be subtracted from total porosity?

soal.question: Jika log neutron dan densitas diplot pada skala yang sama (misalnya batu gamping), efek apa yang terlihat jika formasi mengandung gas?
options: Terjadi cross-over di mana porositas neutron tampak rendah dan porositas densitas tampak tinggi
Porositas neutron tampak sangat tinggi sedangkan porositas densitas tampak sangat rendah
Tidak ada perubahan signifikan pada kedua kurva
soal.correct_option: Terjadi cross-over di mana porositas neutron tampak rendah dan porositas densitas tampak tinggi
soal.question_en: If neutron and density logs are plotted on the same scale (e.g., limestone), what effect is observed if the formation contains gas?
options_en: A cross-over occurs where neutron porosity appears low and density porosity appears high
Neutron porosity appears very high while density porosity appears very low
There is no significant change in both curves
soal.correct_option_en: A cross-over occurs where neutron porosity appears low and density porosity appears high

soal.question: Berapakah rumus kombinasi porositas yang umum digunakan untuk meminimalkan efek gas dalam estimasi porositas total (phi_ND)?
options: phi_ND = akar pangkat dua dari (phi_N^2 + phi_D^2) / 2
soal.correct_option: phi_ND = akar pangkat dua dari (phi_N^2 + phi_D^2) / 2
soal.question_en: What is the common porosity combination formula used to minimize gas effects in total porosity estimation (phi_ND)?
soal.correct_option_en: phi_ND = square root of (phi_N^2 + phi_D^2) / 2

soal.question: Alat log manakah yang prinsip kerjanya berdasarkan waktu tempuh gelombang akustik untuk menentukan porositas?
soal.question_en: Which logging tool uses the travel time of acoustic waves as its working principle to determine porosity?
soal.correct_option_en: Sonic Log

soal.question: Dalam persamaan Archie, berapakah nilai eksponen sementasi m yang umumnya diasumsikan untuk batuan pasir (sandstone) yang terkonsolidasi dengan baik?
soal.question_en: In the Archie equation, what is the cementation exponent m value typically assumed for well-consolidated sandstone?

soal.question: Parameter apa saja yang secara langsung mempengaruhi besarnya faktor formasi (F) dalam model Archie?
soal.question_en: Which parameters directly influence the formation factor (F) in the Archie model?

soal.question: Apa yang terjadi pada faktor formasi (F) jika porositas batuan meningkat sementara parameter lainnya tetap?
soal.question_en: What happens to the formation factor (F) if the rock porosity increases while other parameters remain constant?
soal.correct_option_en: F decreases

soal.question: Eksponen saturasi (n) dalam hukum Archie digunakan untuk menghitung parameter apa?
soal.question_en: The saturation exponent (n) in Archie's law is used to calculate which parameter?
soal.correct_option_en: Resistivity index

soal.question: Persamaan Archie (F = a / phi^m) mendefinisikan faktor formasi sebagai perbandingan antara:
options: Resistivitas formasi jenuh air (Ro) dengan resistivitas air formasi (Rw)
Resistivitas air formasi (Rw) dengan resistivitas batuan (Rt)
soal.correct_option: Resistivitas formasi jenuh air (Ro) dengan resistivitas air formasi (Rw)
soal.question_en: The Archie equation (F = a / phi^m) defines the formation factor as the ratio between:
options_en: Resistivity of water-saturated formation (Ro) to formation water resistivity (Rw)
Formation water resistivity (Rw) to rock resistivity (Rt)
soal.correct_option_en: Resistivity of water-saturated formation (Ro) to formation water resistivity (Rw)

soal.question: Dalam kondisi batuan bersih (clean sand), parameter manakah dalam persamaan Archie yang merepresentasikan konstanta tortuositas?
soal.question_en: In clean sand conditions, which parameter in the Archie equation represents the tortuosity constant?
soal.correct_option_en: a

soal.question: Manakah di antara metode berikut yang digunakan untuk melakukan koreksi pengaruh kandungan lempung (shale) dalam perhitungan saturasi air?
soal.question_en: Which of the following methods are used to correct for the effect of shale content in water saturation calculations?

soal.question: Jika diketahui saturasi air (Sw) pada suatu zona adalah 0.25, berapakah nilai saturasi minyak (So) pada zona tersebut?
soal.question_en: If the water saturation (Sw) in a zone is known to be 0.25, what is the oil saturation (So) value in that zone?

soal.question: Apa kepanjangan dari HCPV dalam evaluasi formasi?
soal.question_en: What does HCPV stand for in formation evaluation?
soal.correct_option_en: Hydrocarbon Pore Volume

soal.question: Parameter 'n' dalam persamaan Archie merepresentasikan apa?
soal.question_en: What does the parameter 'n' in the Archie equation represent?
soal.correct_option_en: Saturation exponent

soal.question: Parameter utama yang paling umum digunakan dalam penentuan batas (cut-off) untuk memisahkan batuan reservoir dari non-reservoir adalah
soal.question_en: Which main parameter is most commonly used in determining the cut-off to distinguish reservoir rock from non-reservoir rock?
soal.correct_option_en: Porosity

soal.question: Manakah pernyataan yang benar mengenai hubungan antara Net Reservoir dan Net Pay?
options: Net Reservoir harus memenuhi kriteria cut-off porositas
Net Pay harus memenuhi kriteria cut-off saturasi air (Sw)
Net Reservoir selalu lebih kecil dari Net Pay
Net Pay adalah bagian dari Net Reservoir yang memiliki saturasi hidrokarbon produktif
correct_option: Net Reservoir harus memenuhi kriteria cut-off porositas
Net Pay harus memenuhi kriteria cut-off saturasi air (Sw)
Net Pay adalah bagian dari Net Reservoir yang memiliki saturasi hidrokarbon produktif
soal.question_en: Which statements are correct regarding the relationship between Net Reservoir and Net Pay?
options_en: Net Reservoir must meet the porosity cut-off criteria
Net Pay must meet the water saturation (Sw) cut-off criteria
Net Reservoir is always smaller than Net Pay
Net Pay is the portion of Net Reservoir that has productive hydrocarbon saturation
correct_option_en: Net Reservoir must meet the porosity cut-off criteria
Net Pay must meet the water saturation (Sw) cut-off criteria
Net Pay is the portion of Net Reservoir that has productive hydrocarbon saturation

soal.question: Rasio antara ketebalan net pay dengan ketebalan total formasi (gross thickness) dikenal dengan istilah
soal.question_en: The ratio between net pay thickness and total formation thickness (gross thickness) is known as
soal.correct_option_en: Net-to-Gross (NTG)

soal.question: Dalam evaluasi formasi, mengapa batasan Volume of Shale (Vsh) diterapkan sebagai cut-off?
options: Untuk membatasi kandungan lempung yang mengurangi permeabilitas efektif
soal.correct_option: Untuk membatasi kandungan lempung yang mengurangi permeabilitas efektif
soal.question_en: In formation evaluation, why is a Volume of Shale (Vsh) cut-off applied?
options_en: To limit clay content that reduces effective permeability
To increase the rock resistivity value
To reduce the total porosity value
soal.correct_option_en: To limit clay content that reduces effective permeability

soal.question: Apa dampak utama dari pemilihan nilai cut-off yang terlalu ketat (terlalu tinggi) pada perhitungan Original Oil In Place (OOIP)?
soal.question_en: What is the main impact of selecting a cut-off value that is too strict (too high) on the Original Oil In Place (OOIP) calculation?
options_en: It has no effect on OOIP estimation
soal.correct_option_en: OOIP will be underestimated

soal.question: Metode korelasi log yang paling umum digunakan untuk menghubungkan karakteristik lapisan antar sumur dalam satu lapangan adalah dengan menggunakan marker utama berupa lapisan yang memiliki?
options: Sifat batuan yang kontinu dan mudah diidentifikasi (seperti lapisan shale tebal)
Nilai gamma ray yang tidak menentu
soal.correct_option: Sifat batuan yang kontinu dan mudah diidentifikasi (seperti lapisan shale tebal)
soal.question_en: The most common log correlation method used to connect layer characteristics between wells in a field is by using primary markers that have?
options_en: Continuous rock properties that are easily identified (such as thick shale layers)
soal.correct_option_en: Continuous rock properties that are easily identified (such as thick shale layers)

soal.question: Manakah di antara log berikut yang paling efektif digunakan untuk menentukan kontak fluida (seperti Oil-Water Contact) dalam formasi reservoir?
soal.question_en: Which of the following logs are most effective for determining fluid contacts (such as Oil-Water Contact) in a reservoir formation?

soal.question: Apa tujuan utama dari melakukan zonasi reservoir dalam evaluasi formasi?
options: Untuk memisahkan lapisan berdasarkan karakteristik petrofisika yang seragam agar perhitungan cadangan lebih akurat
Untuk menghilangkan kebutuhan melakukan core analysis
Untuk menyamakan nilai permeabilitas di seluruh kedalaman sumur
soal.correct_option: Untuk memisahkan lapisan berdasarkan karakteristik petrofisika yang seragam agar perhitungan cadangan lebih akurat
soal.question_en: What is the primary objective of performing reservoir zoning in formation evaluation?
options_en: To separate layers based on uniform petrophysical characteristics for more accurate reserve calculations
To eliminate the need for core analysis
To equalize permeability values across the entire well depth
soal.correct_option_en: To separate layers based on uniform petrophysical characteristics for more accurate reserve calculations

soal.question: Dalam korelasi sumur, jika ditemukan pergeseran lapisan secara vertikal pada kedalaman yang berbeda di sumur yang berdekatan, hal ini kemungkinan besar mengindikasikan adanya?
soal.question_en: In well correlation, if a vertical layer displacement is observed at different depths in adjacent wells, this most likely indicates?
options_en: The presence of geological structures such as a fault
soal.correct_option_en: The presence of geological structures such as a fault

soal.question: Penyajian hasil interpretasi log yang komprehensif (composite log) biasanya memuat data berikut, kecuali?
options: Hasil perhitungan porositas dan saturasi air
soal.question_en: A comprehensive log interpretation presentation (composite log) typically includes the following data, except?
options_en: Porosity and water saturation calculation results
soal.correct_option_en: Regional seismic activity log

soal.question: Parameter utama yang digunakan untuk menghitung volume shale (Vsh) menggunakan log Gamma Ray adalah...
soal.question_en: The main parameter used to calculate shale volume (Vsh) using Gamma Ray logs is...
soal.correct_option_en: Gamma Ray Index (IGR)

soal.question: Faktor apa saja yang harus dipertimbangkan saat melakukan koreksi shale pada perhitungan porositas efektif?
soal.question_en: What factors must be considered when applying shale corrections to effective porosity calculations?

soal.question: Pada kondisi bersih (clean sand), berapakah nilai IGR yang ideal?
soal.question_en: In clean sand conditions, what is the ideal IGR value?

soal.question: Apa dampak keberadaan shale terhadap porositas total yang terukur oleh alat logging?
options: Menyebabkan porositas terbaca lebih besar dari porositas efektif
soal.correct_option: Menyebabkan porositas terbaca lebih besar dari porositas efektif
soal.question_en: What is the impact of shale presence on the total porosity measured by logging tools?
options_en: Causes porosity to be read higher than effective porosity
soal.correct_option_en: Causes porosity to be read higher than effective porosity

soal.question: Rumus linear sederhana untuk menghitung Vsh adalah Vsh = (GRlog - GRclean) / (GRshale - GRclean). Apa batasan utama rumus ini?
options: Sering memberikan nilai Vsh yang terlalu optimis (terlalu rendah)
soal.correct_option: Sering memberikan nilai Vsh yang terlalu optimis (terlalu rendah)
soal.question_en: The simple linear formula for calculating Vsh is Vsh = (GRlog - GRclean) / (GRshale - GRclean). What is the main limitation of this formula?
options_en: Often provides overly optimistic (too low) Vsh values
Does not require GR clean values
soal.correct_option_en: Often provides overly optimistic (too low) Vsh values

soal.question: Manakah pernyataan yang benar mengenai porositas efektif?
options: Bagian dari porositas total yang saling terhubung dan tidak terikat oleh mineral lempung
Porositas yang dihitung sebelum koreksi shale
Porositas yang hanya diukur di laboratorium
soal.correct_option: Bagian dari porositas total yang saling terhubung dan tidak terikat oleh mineral lempung
soal.question_en: Which statement is correct regarding effective porosity?
options_en: The part of total porosity that is interconnected and not bound by clay minerals
The total pore volume in rock
Porosity measured only in the laboratory
soal.correct_option_en: The part of total porosity that is interconnected and not bound by clay minerals

soal.question: Kapan penggunaan koreksi shale non-linear (seperti rumus Steiber atau Clavier) lebih disarankan?
options: Ketika data GR menunjukkan adanya variasi shale yang kompleks
Pada formasi karbonat yang sangat murni
Ketika nilai GR log konstan sepanjang sumur
correct_option: Ketika data GR menunjukkan adanya variasi shale yang kompleks
soal.question_en: When is the use of non-linear shale corrections (such as Steiber or Clavier formulas) more recommended?
options_en: When GR data shows complex shale variations
When GR log values are constant throughout the well
correct_option_en: When GR data shows complex shale variations

soal.question: Log SP (Spontaneous Potential) dapat digunakan untuk menentukan volume shale dengan cara membandingkan defleksi SP pada zona formasi dengan...
options: Defleksi SP pada zona shale (SSP dan PSP)
soal.correct_option: Defleksi SP pada zona shale (SSP dan PSP)
soal.question_en: The SP log can be used to determine shale volume by comparing the SP deflection in the formation zone with...
options_en: SP deflection in the shale zone (SSP and PSP)
soal.correct_option_en: SP deflection in the shale zone (SSP and PSP)

soal.question: Apa pengaruh air terikat lempung (bound water) pada perhitungan porositas dari log densitas?
options: Menyebabkan nilai porositas yang terhitung menjadi lebih besar
soal.correct_option: Menyebabkan nilai porositas yang terhitung menjadi lebih besar
soal.question_en: What is the effect of clay-bound water on porosity calculations from density logs?
options_en: Causes the calculated porosity value to be higher
soal.correct_option_en: Causes the calculated porosity value to be higher

soal.question: Untuk menghitung porositas efektif dari porositas total, parameter apa yang biasanya dikurangkan?
options: Produk dari volume shale (Vsh) dan porositas shale (phi_shale)
soal.correct_option: Produk dari volume shale (Vsh) dan porositas shale (phi_shale)
soal.question_en: To calculate effective porosity from total porosity, what parameter is usually subtracted?
options_en: The product of shale volume (Vsh) and shale porosity (phi_shale)
soal.correct_option_en: The product of shale volume (Vsh) and shale porosity (phi_shale)

soal.question: Dalam persamaan Archie, berapakah nilai eksponen sementasi (m) yang umum digunakan untuk batuan pasir (sandstone) yang terkonsolidasi?
soal.question_en: In the Archie equation, what is the typical cementation exponent (m) value used for consolidated sandstone?

soal.question: Faktor formasi (F) didefinisikan sebagai rasio antara resistivitas batuan yang jenuh air 100% (Ro) terhadap apa?
soal.question_en: Formation factor (F) is defined as the ratio between the resistivity of a 100% water-saturated rock (Ro) and what?
soal.correct_option_en: Formation water resistivity

soal.question: Parameter apa saja yang secara langsung mempengaruhi besarnya faktor formasi (F) dalam model Archie?
soal.question_en: Which parameters directly affect the formation factor (F) in the Archie model?

soal.question: Jika resistivitas air formasi (Rw) meningkat, maka untuk nilai porositas yang tetap, bagaimanakah pengaruhnya terhadap resistivitas batuan (Ro)?
soal.question_en: If the formation water resistivity (Rw) increases, what is the effect on the rock resistivity (Ro) assuming constant porosity?
soal.correct_option_en: Ro will increase

soal.question: Apa yang dimaksud dengan indeks resistivitas (I) dalam hubungan Archie?
soal.question_en: What is meant by the resistivity index (I) in the Archie relationship?
soal.correct_option_en: Ratio of Rt to Ro

soal.question: Dalam persamaan Archie, eksponen saturasi (n) umumnya diasumsikan bernilai berapa untuk kebanyakan reservoir?
soal.question_en: In the Archie equation, the saturation exponent (n) is generally assumed to be what value for most reservoirs?

soal.question: Batasan utama penggunaan persamaan Archie adalah?
options: Hanya berlaku untuk batuan dengan kandungan lempung tinggi
Hanya berlaku untuk formasi yang tidak mengandung mineral konduktif
Hanya berlaku jika hidrokarbon dalam fase gas
soal.correct_option: Hanya berlaku untuk formasi yang tidak mengandung mineral konduktif
soal.question_en: What is the main limitation of using the Archie equation?
options_en: Only valid for high clay content rocks
Only valid for formations without conductive minerals
Only valid if hydrocarbons are in the gas phase
soal.correct_option_en: Only valid for formations without conductive minerals

soal.question: Jika nilai indeks resistivitas (I) adalah 4, dan eksponen saturasi (n) adalah 2, berapakah saturasi air (Sw) batuan tersebut?
soal.question_en: If the resistivity index (I) is 4, and the saturation exponent (n) is 2, what is the water saturation (Sw) of the rock?

soal.question: Parameter 'a' dalam persamaan Archie (F = a / phi^m) merepresentasikan apa?
soal.question_en: What does the parameter 'a' in the Archie equation (F = a / phi^m) represent?
soal.correct_option_en: Tortuosity coefficient

soal.question: Manakah pernyataan yang benar mengenai hubungan resistivitas batuan (Rt) dengan saturasi air (Sw) menurut Archie?
soal.question_en: Which statement is correct regarding the relationship between rock resistivity (Rt) and water saturation (Sw) according to Archie?
options_en: Rt is directly proportional to Sw
Rt is inversely proportional to Sw^n
Rt is not influenced by Sw
Rt is directly proportional to Sw^2
soal.correct_option_en: Rt is inversely proportional to Sw^n

soal.question: Apakah perbedaan utama antara net reservoir dan net pay dalam evaluasi formasi?
options: Net reservoir mencakup seluruh zona berpori, sedangkan net pay mencakup zona berpori yang memiliki saturasi hidrokarbon ekonomis
Net pay mencakup seluruh zona permeabel, sedangkan net reservoir hanya zona produktif
Net reservoir hanya mencakup batuan dengan permeabilitas tinggi
soal.correct_option: Net reservoir mencakup seluruh zona berpori, sedangkan net pay mencakup zona berpori yang memiliki saturasi hidrokarbon ekonomis
soal.question_en: What is the main difference between net reservoir and net pay in formation evaluation?
options_en: Net reservoir includes all porous zones, while net pay includes porous zones with economic hydrocarbon saturation
Net pay includes all permeable zones, while net reservoir only includes productive zones
There is no difference between them
Net reservoir only includes high permeability rocks
soal.correct_option_en: Net reservoir includes all porous zones, while net pay includes porous zones with economic hydrocarbon saturation

soal.question_en: Which statement best defines the Recovery Factor (RF) in the context of an oil reservoir?

Total volume of water injected into the reservoir to push oil
The ratio between oil viscosity and water viscosity at reservoir conditions

soal.question: Apa yang dimaksud dengan Residual Oil Saturation (Sor) dalam konteks reservoir minyak?

Jumlah minyak awal yang terdapat di dalam reservoir sebelum produksi dimulai
Volume minyak yang dapat diproduksi secara ekonomis menggunakan metode primary recovery
Persentase minyak yang mengalir bebas melalui pori-pori batuan menuju lubang sumur
soal.correct_option: Saturasi minyak yang tersisa setelah proses pengurasan atau pendesakan yang tidak dapat diproduksi secara teknis
soal.question_en: What is meant by Residual Oil Saturation (Sor) in the context of an oil reservoir?
options_en: The oil saturation remaining after a depletion or displacement process that cannot be technically produced
The initial amount of oil contained in the reservoir before production begins
The volume of oil that can be economically produced using primary recovery methods
The percentage of oil that flows freely through rock pores toward the wellbore
soal.correct_option_en: The oil saturation remaining after a depletion or displacement process that cannot be technically produced

Adanya gaya gravitasi yang membantu pergerakan minyak
Hambatan viskositas minyak yang sangat rendah
Heterogenitas batuan reservoir yang menyebabkan bypass
correct_option: Gaya kapiler yang menahan minyak di dalam pori kecil
Heterogenitas batuan reservoir yang menyebabkan bypass
soal.question_en: What are the main factors that cause oil to be trapped as Residual Oil Saturation within rock pores?
options_en: Capillary forces that hold oil within small pores
Gravitational forces that assist oil movement
correct_option_en: Capillary forces that hold oil within small pores

soal.question: Dalam aplikasi Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR), mengapa target utama EOR adalah mengurangi nilai Sor?
options: Karena nilai Sor yang rendah menunjukkan bahwa minyak sudah habis sepenuhnya
Karena Sor mewakili cadangan minyak yang tidak dapat diambil dengan metode konvensional
Karena mengurangi Sor akan menurunkan tekanan reservoir secara drastis
Karena Sor harus ditingkatkan agar efisiensi pendesakan minyak lebih baik
soal.correct_option: Karena Sor mewakili cadangan minyak yang tidak dapat diambil dengan metode konvensional
soal.question_en: In Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR) applications, why is the primary target of EOR to reduce the Sor value?
options_en: Because a low Sor value indicates that the oil has been completely depleted
Because Sor represents oil reserves that cannot be recovered by conventional methods
Because reducing Sor will drastically lower reservoir pressure
Because Sor must be increased so that oil displacement efficiency is better
soal.correct_option_en: Because Sor represents oil reserves that cannot be recovered by conventional methods

Semakin rendah IFT, semakin rendah nilai Sor karena gaya kapiler berkurang
IFT tidak memiliki pengaruh terhadap nilai saturasi minyak residu
Semakin rendah IFT, semakin tinggi nilai Sor karena minyak terdispersi minyak meningkat
soal.correct_option: Semakin rendah IFT, semakin rendah nilai Sor karena gaya kapiler berkurang
soal.question_en: How does Interfacial Tension (IFT) affect the Sor value during an oil displacement process?
options_en: The higher the IFT, the lower the Sor value because oil moves more easily
The lower the IFT, the lower the Sor value because capillary forces are reduced
IFT has no influence on the residual oil saturation value
The lower the IFT, the higher the Sor value because oil dispersion increases
soal.correct_option_en: The lower the IFT, the lower the Sor value because capillary forces are reduced

Because high salinity naturally lowers oil viscosity

Mengubah sifat kimia minyak mentah di reservoir
Menghilangkan efek gravitasi di dalam reservoir
soal.correct_option: Menjangkau minyak di zona yang sebelumnya tidak tersapu oleh air injeksi
soal.question_en: Which of the following is a primary objective of improving volumetric sweep efficiency?
options_en: Contacting oil in zones previously unswept by injection water
Changing the chemical properties of crude oil in the reservoir
Eliminating gravitational effects in the reservoir
soal.correct_option_en: Contacting oil in zones previously unswept by injection water

soal.question: Apa perbedaan utama antara polimer sintetik HPAM dan biopolimer Xanthan dalam konteks injeksi polimer?
options: HPAM bersifat pseudoplastik sedangkan Xanthan bersifat Newtonian
HPAM lebih tahan terhadap salinitas tinggi dibandingkan Xanthan
Struktur molekul HPAM berbentuk rantai linier fleksibel sedangkan Xanthan memiliki struktur heliks kaku
Xanthan mengalami degradasi mekanik yang lebih parah dibandingkan HPAM
soal.correct_option: Struktur molekul HPAM berbentuk rantai linier fleksibel sedangkan Xanthan memiliki struktur heliks kaku
soal.question_en: What is the main difference between synthetic HPAM polymers and Xanthan biopolymers in the context of polymer injection?
options_en: HPAM is pseudoplastic while Xanthan is Newtonian
HPAM is more resistant to high salinity compared to Xanthan
HPAM molecular structure is a flexible linear chain while Xanthan has a rigid helical structure
Xanthan undergoes more severe mechanical degradation than HPAM
soal.correct_option_en: HPAM molecular structure is a flexible linear chain while Xanthan has a rigid helical structure

soal.question: Sifat rheologi polimer HPAM sangat dipengaruhi oleh salinitas. Apa yang terjadi pada viskositas larutan HPAM saat salinitas air formasi meningkat?
options: Viskositas menurun karena efek pelipatan rantai polimer (coiling)
Viskositas tetap stabil tanpa dipengaruhi ion
Viskositas meningkat karena pemanjangan rantai polimer
soal.correct_option: Viskositas menurun karena efek pelipatan rantai polimer (coiling)
soal.question_en: The rheological properties of HPAM polymers are highly influenced by salinity. What happens to the viscosity of HPAM solutions when formation water salinity increases?
options_en: Viscosity decreases due to the polymer chain coiling effect
Viscosity remains stable regardless of ions
Viscosity increases due to polymer chain elongation
soal.correct_option_en: Viscosity decreases due to the polymer chain coiling effect

soal.question: Manakah faktor-faktor berikut yang dapat menyebabkan degradasi mekanik pada polimer saat melewati media berpori?
options: Laju alir yang sangat tinggi melalui pori-pori kecil
Tekanan injeksi yang melebihi batas kekuatan tarik polimer
Kadar salinitas yang rendah dalam fluida
Suhu reservoir yang di bawah 50 derajat Celsius
correct_option: Laju alir yang sangat tinggi melalui pori-pori kecil
Tekanan injeksi yang melebihi batas kekuatan tarik polimer
soal.question_en: Which of the following factors can cause mechanical degradation of polymers when passing through porous media?
options_en: Very high flow rates through small pores
Injection pressure exceeding the polymer tensile strength limit
Low salinity levels in the fluid
correct_option_en: Very high flow rates through small pores
Injection pressure exceeding the polymer tensile strength limit

soal.question: Mengapa Xanthan Gum dianggap lebih unggul dibandingkan HPAM dalam kondisi reservoir dengan salinitas yang tinggi?
options: Karena Xanthan memiliki berat molekul yang lebih rendah
Karena struktur heliks Xanthan melindunginya dari efek screening ion
Karena Xanthan lebih murah secara ekonomi
Karena Xanthan mudah terdegradasi secara biologis
soal.correct_option: Karena struktur heliks Xanthan melindunginya dari efek screening ion
soal.question_en: Why is Xanthan Gum considered superior to HPAM in reservoir conditions with high salinity?
options_en: Because Xanthan has a lower molecular weight
Because Xanthan's helical structure protects it from ion screening effects
Because Xanthan is more economically affordable
soal.correct_option_en: Because Xanthan's helical structure protects it from ion screening effects

soal.question: Dalam uji laboratorium, fenomena apa yang terjadi jika laju geser (shear rate) pada larutan polimer ditingkatkan?
soal.question_en: In laboratory tests, what phenomenon occurs if the shear rate of a polymer solution is increased?
options_en: The polymer solution exhibits shear-thinning (pseudoplastic) properties
The polymer solution exhibits dilatant (shear-thickening) properties
There is no change in viscosity
soal.correct_option_en: The polymer solution exhibits shear-thinning (pseudoplastic) properties

soal.question: Apa dampak negatif dari degradasi termal pada polimer HPAM di reservoir dengan suhu tinggi?
options: Pemutusan rantai polimer yang menyebabkan penurunan viskositas
Pembentukan endapan padat yang menyumbat pori
Peningkatan kemampuan polimer untuk menyapu minyak
soal.correct_option: Pemutusan rantai polimer yang menyebabkan penurunan viskositas
soal.question_en: What is the negative impact of thermal degradation on HPAM polymers in high-temperature reservoirs?
options_en: Polymer chain scission leading to viscosity loss
Formation of solid deposits that plug pores
soal.correct_option_en: Polymer chain scission leading to viscosity loss

soal.question: Manakah pernyataan yang benar mengenai sifat rheologi polimer Xanthan?
options: Viskositasnya tidak sensitif terhadap konsentrasi garam
Menunjukkan viskositas tinggi pada laju geser rendah
Sangat mudah terdegradasi oleh bakteri jika tidak diberi biosida
Bersifat Newtonian murni pada semua laju geser
correct_option: Viskositasnya tidak sensitif terhadap konsentrasi garam
Menunjukkan viskositas tinggi pada laju geser rendah
Sangat mudah terdegradasi oleh bakteri jika tidak diberi biosida
soal.question_en: Which statements are correct regarding the rheological properties of Xanthan polymers?
options_en: Its viscosity is insensitive to salt concentration
Shows high viscosity at low shear rates
Highly susceptible to bacterial degradation if not treated with biocides
Is purely Newtonian at all shear rates
correct_option_en: Its viscosity is insensitive to salt concentration
Shows high viscosity at low shear rates
Highly susceptible to bacterial degradation if not treated with biocides

soal.question: Bagaimana pengaruh penambahan polimer terhadap mobilitas fluida di dalam reservoir?
options: Menurunkan mobilitas dengan meningkatkan viskositas larutan
Tidak mengubah mobilitas fluida sama sekali
soal.correct_option: Menurunkan mobilitas dengan meningkatkan viskositas larutan
soal.question_en: How does the addition of polymers affect fluid mobility within the reservoir?
options_en: Decreases mobility by increasing solution viscosity
Does not change fluid mobility at all
soal.correct_option_en: Decreases mobility by increasing solution viscosity

soal.question: Faktor apa yang paling menentukan ketahanan polimer HPAM terhadap degradasi hidrolisis dalam lingkungan reservoir?
soal.question_en: What factor most determines the resistance of HPAM polymers to hydrolysis degradation in the reservoir environment?
options_en: Degree of hydrolysis and reservoir temperature
soal.correct_option_en: Degree of hydrolysis and reservoir temperature

soal.question: Dalam konteks aplikasi EOR, apa yang dimaksud dengan 'adsorpsi polimer'?
options: Penempelan molekul polimer pada permukaan butiran batuan
Larutnya polimer ke dalam fase minyak
Proses penguapan polimer di dalam pori
soal.correct_option: Penempelan molekul polimer pada permukaan butiran batuan
soal.question_en: In the context of EOR applications, what is meant by 'polymer adsorption'?
options_en: Attachment of polymer molecules to the rock grain surface
Dissolution of polymer into the oil phase
Process of polymer evaporation within the pores
Mixing of polymers with CO2 gas
soal.correct_option_en: Attachment of polymer molecules to the rock grain surface

soal.question: Apa parameter utama yang menentukan mobilitas fluida injeksi dalam desain polymer flooding?
options: Temperatur formasi dan saturasi minyak sisa
Salinitas air formasi dan kelarutan polimer
soal.question_en: What is the primary parameter determining injection fluid mobility in polymer flooding design?
options_en: Formation temperature and residual oil saturation
Formation water salinity and polymer solubility
soal.correct_option_en: Polymer viscosity and rock permeability

soal.question: Faktor apa saja yang harus dipertimbangkan dalam menentukan ukuran slug (slug size) polimer?
soal.question_en: What factors must be considered when determining the polymer slug size?

soal.question: Bagaimana pengaruh peningkatan konsentrasi polimer terhadap injektivitas di dalam reservoir?

soal.question_en: How does increasing polymer concentration affect injectivity within the reservoir?
options_en: Injectivity decreases due to increased viscosity
Injectivity increases due to decreased viscosity
soal.correct_option_en: Injectivity decreases due to increased viscosity

soal.question: Apa yang dimaksud dengan 'adsorpsi polimer' dalam konteks desain CEOR?
options: Kehilangan polimer akibat menempel pada permukaan batuan
Reaksi kimia polimer dengan minyak mentah
soal.correct_option: Kehilangan polimer akibat menempel pada permukaan batuan
soal.question_en: What is meant by 'polymer adsorption' in the context of CEOR design?
options_en: Polymer loss due to attachment to rock surfaces
Polymer concentration increase due to evaporation
Chemical reaction of polymer with crude oil
soal.correct_option_en: Polymer loss due to attachment to rock surfaces

soal.question: Dalam studi kasus implementasi lapangan, apa tantangan utama penggunaan polimer HPAM pada reservoir dengan salinitas tinggi?
options: Kebutuhan tekanan injeksi yang sangat rendah
soal.question_en: In field implementation case studies, what is the main challenge of using HPAM polymers in high-salinity reservoirs?
options_en: Viscosity degradation due to salinity sensitivity
Requirement for very low injection pressure
soal.correct_option_en: Viscosity degradation due to salinity sensitivity

soal.question: Apa tujuan utama penambahan 'tracer' dalam uji injeksi polimer?
soal.question_en: What is the primary purpose of adding a 'tracer' in polymer injection tests?
soal.correct_option_en: To track fluid flow paths

soal.question: Fenomena apa yang menyebabkan hambatan aliran (resistance factor) meningkat selama injeksi polimer?
soal.question_en: What phenomenon causes the resistance factor to increase during polymer injection?
soal.correct_option_en: Pore plugging and viscoelasticity

soal.question: Manakah pernyataan yang benar mengenai desain slug polimer?
options: Konsentrasi polimer disesuaikan dengan viskositas minyak
Ukuran slug biasanya berkisar antara 0.5 hingga 1.0 pore volume
Suhu reservoir tidak mempengaruhi stabilitas polimer
Kompatibilitas polimer dengan air formasi harus diuji
correct_option: Konsentrasi polimer disesuaikan dengan viskositas minyak
Ukuran slug biasanya berkisar antara 0.5 hingga 1.0 pore volume
Kompatibilitas polimer dengan air formasi harus diuji
soal.question_en: Which statements are true regarding polymer slug design?
options_en: Polymer concentration is adjusted to oil viscosity
Slug size is typically 0.5 to 1.0 pore volume
Reservoir temperature does not affect polymer stability
Polymer compatibility with formation water must be tested
correct_option_en: Polymer concentration is adjusted to oil viscosity
Slug size is typically 0.5 to 1.0 pore volume
Polymer compatibility with formation water must be tested

soal.question: Mengapa 'shear degradation' menjadi perhatian serius dalam desain fasilitas permukaan injeksi polimer?
options: Karena dapat menurunkan berat molekul polimer dan viskositas
Karena menyebabkan korosi pada pipa injeksi
soal.correct_option: Karena dapat menurunkan berat molekul polimer dan viskositas
soal.question_en: Why is 'shear degradation' a serious concern in the design of polymer injection surface facilities?
options_en: Because it can reduce polymer molecular weight and viscosity
Because it causes corrosion in injection pipes
Because it increases pump operating costs
Because it causes oil-water phase separation
soal.correct_option_en: Because it can reduce polymer molecular weight and viscosity

soal.question: Apa dampak utama dari keberhasilan desain mobilitas rasio dalam polymer flooding?
options: Eliminasi total dari air sisa di reservoir

soal.question: Apa kelemahan utama penggunaan HPAM (Hydrolyzed Polyacrylamide) pada kondisi reservoir dengan salinitas tinggi?
options: Sensitif terhadap salinitas tinggi yang menyebabkan penurunan viskositas

soal.correct_option_en: More resistant to high salinity

soal.correct_option_en: Adsorption

soal.question: Dalam desain slug polimer, apa yang dimaksud dengan tapering?
soal.question_en: In polymer slug design, what is meant by tapering?
soal.correct_option_en: Gradual reduction of polymer concentration

soal.question: Apa dampak negatif dari degradasi mekanis (shear degradation) pada polimer HPAM?
options: Penurunan berat molekul dan kehilangan viskositas
soal.correct_option: Penurunan berat molekul dan kehilangan viskositas
soal.question_en: What is the negative impact of shear degradation on HPAM polymer?
options_en: Reduction in molecular weight and loss of viscosity

soal.question: Mengapa injeksi polimer lebih unggul daripada waterflooding konvensional dalam hal perolehan minyak?

Menghilangkan kebutuhan akan fasilitas pengolahan air
soal.correct_option: Memperbaiki vertical dan areal sweep efficiency
soal.question_en: Why is polymer injection superior to conventional waterflooding in terms of oil recovery?
options_en: Improves vertical and areal sweep efficiency
Eliminates the need for water treatment facilities
soal.correct_option_en: Improves vertical and areal sweep efficiency

soal.question: Apa tujuan utama dari proses pre-flush dalam desain Chemical EOR?

Membersihkan sisa bor di dekat lubang sumur
soal.correct_option: Menyesuaikan salinitas dan pH lingkungan reservoir

options_en: Adjusting salinity and pH of the reservoir environment
Cleaning drilling residue near the wellbore

soal.question_en: How does very high reservoir temperature affect the chemical stability of HPAM?
soal.correct_option_en: Accelerates hydrolysis and polymer degradation

soal.question: Dalam konteks polimer flooding, apa yang dimaksud dengan 'resistance factor'?
options: Rasio mobilitas air terhadap mobilitas larutan polimer
Rasio viskositas polimer terhadap viskositas air
Rasio permeabilitas batuan setelah dan sebelum injeksi
soal.correct_option: Rasio mobilitas air terhadap mobilitas larutan polimer
soal.question_en: In the context of polymer flooding, what is meant by 'resistance factor'?
options_en: Ratio of water mobility to polymer solution mobility
Ratio of polymer viscosity to water viscosity
Ratio of rock permeability after and before injection
soal.correct_option_en: Ratio of water mobility to polymer solution mobility

options_en: Formation plugging due to high viscosity
Injection pump damage due to corrosion

soal.question: Apa keuntungan menggunakan polimer dibandingkan dengan waterflooding saja pada reservoir heterogen?
options: Mengurangi aliran melalui zona dengan permeabilitas tinggi (thief zones)
Menggantikan seluruh volume minyak dalam reservoir
soal.correct_option: Mengurangi aliran melalui zona dengan permeabilitas tinggi (thief zones)
soal.question_en: What is the advantage of using polymer compared to waterflooding alone in heterogeneous reservoirs?
options_en: Reduces flow through high permeability zones (thief zones)
Replaces the entire oil volume in the reservoir
soal.correct_option_en: Reduces flow through high permeability zones (thief zones)

soal.question: Apa fungsi utama penambahan surfaktan dalam proses Chemical Enhanced Oil Recovery (CEOR)?
options: Menurunkan tegangan antarmuka (IFT) antara minyak dan air
Meningkatkan viskositas air injeksi secara signifikan
Mengubah wettability batuan menjadi water-wet secara permanen
Menambah tekanan reservoir agar minyak terdesak ke lubang bor
soal.correct_option: Menurunkan tegangan antarmuka (IFT) antara minyak dan air
soal.question_en: What is the main function of adding surfactants in the Chemical Enhanced Oil Recovery (CEOR) process?
options_en: Reducing the interfacial tension (IFT) between oil and water
Significantly increasing the viscosity of the injected water
Permanently changing rock wettability to water-wet
Increasing reservoir pressure to push oil into the wellbore
soal.correct_option_en: Reducing the interfacial tension (IFT) between oil and water

soal.question: Berapa nilai tegangan antarmuka (IFT) yang dikategorikan sebagai ultralow yang efektif untuk memobilisasi minyak terperangkap?
soal.question_en: What is the interfacial tension (IFT) value categorized as ultralow that is effective for mobilizing trapped oil?
soal.correct_option_en: Less than 10^-2 mN/m

soal.question: Faktor apa saja yang dipengaruhi secara langsung oleh peningkatan capillary number (Nc) dalam surfactant flooding?
soal.question_en: Which factors are directly influenced by the increase of capillary number (Nc) in surfactant flooding?

soal.question: Bagaimana hubungan antara capillary number (Nc) dan recovery factor dalam reservoir?
options: Berbanding terbalik, semakin tinggi Nc semakin rendah recovery factor
Berbanding lurus, semakin tinggi Nc semakin tinggi potensi recovery factor
Recovery factor hanya bergantung pada porositas, bukan Nc

soal.question_en: What is the relationship between capillary number (Nc) and recovery factor in a reservoir?
options_en: Inversely proportional, higher Nc leads to lower recovery factor
There is no relationship at all
Directly proportional, higher Nc leads to higher potential recovery factor
Recovery factor depends only on porosity, not Nc

soal.question: Apa mekanisme fisik utama surfaktan dalam mendesorpsi minyak dari permukaan batuan?
options: Menurunkan gaya adhesi antara minyak dan permukaan batuan
Membekukan minyak agar lebih mudah terdorong
soal.correct_option: Menurunkan gaya adhesi antara minyak dan permukaan batuan
soal.question_en: What is the main physical mechanism of surfactants in desorbing oil from rock surfaces?

Freezing the oil to make it easier to push
soal.correct_option_en: Reducing the adhesive force between oil and rock surfaces

soal.question: Faktor apa saja yang mempengaruhi solubilization ratio dalam sistem surfaktan-minyak-air?
soal.question_en: What factors influence the solubilization ratio in a surfactant-oil-water system?

soal.question: Apa yang terjadi jika salinitas sistem surfaktan berada di atas salinitas optimal dalam konteks perilaku fase?
options: Sistem membentuk fase mikroemulsi Winsor III
Sistem cenderung membentuk perilaku fase Winsor II
Sistem cenderung membentuk perilaku fase Winsor I
Tegangan antar muka mencapai titik minimum absolut
soal.correct_option: Sistem cenderung membentuk perilaku fase Winsor II
soal.question_en: What happens if the salinity of a surfactant system is above the optimal salinity in the context of phase behavior?
options_en: The system forms a Winsor III microemulsion phase

The system tends to form Winsor I phase behavior

soal.question: Mengapa surfaktan nonionik sering ditambahkan ke dalam formulasi surfaktan anionik dalam kondisi salinitas tinggi?

Untuk mempercepat laju korosi peralatan injeksi

soal.question_en: Why are nonionic surfactants often added to anionic surfactant formulations in high salinity conditions?
options_en: To increase the viscosity of the solution
To increase surfactant adsorption on the rock
To increase tolerance to salinity and divalent ions
To accelerate the corrosion rate of injection equipment

soal.question: Apa fungsi utama penambahan agen alkali seperti NaOH atau Na2CO3 dalam proses Alkaline Flooding?

soal.question_en: What is the primary function of adding alkaline agents such as NaOH or Na2CO3 in the Alkaline Flooding process?
options_en: Reducing Interfacial Tension (IFT) through in-situ soap formation
Blocking rock pores to direct fluid flow
Reducing injection pressure without affecting interfacial tension

soal.question: Reaksi kimia antara alkali dengan asam organik (asam naphthenic) yang terkandung dalam minyak mentah disebut sebagai proses?

correct_option: Minyak menjadi kurang melekat pada permukaan batuan

correct_option_en: Oil becomes less adhered to the rock surface

soal.question: Apa dampak negatif utama yang harus dipertimbangkan terkait konsumsi alkali oleh mineral batuan reservoir?
options: Hilangnya efektivitas alkali karena bereaksi dengan mineral batuan
